codes.name: Small rituals to start and stop
codes.description: Walks, shoes, lanyards, a shirt, words said to a room: small acts made up to mark when work starts and stops.

codes.name: The commute as a buffer, gone
codes.description: The journey that once stood between work and home, missed for the gap it made rather than for itself.

codes.name: Work seeping into evenings
codes.description: Checking, replying and working after hours because work is within reach and nothing says stop.

codes.name: No room that is only home
codes.description: Living and sleeping beside work in rooms that used to be only home.

codes.name: Shutting work away
codes.description: Laptops into baskets, boxes and drawers, a door shut or a t-shirt over the screen: work put out of sight for the night.

codes.name: Staying visible online
codes.description: The green dot, the fast reply, first on in the morning: making yourself seen to be at work.

codes.name: Guilt at home's ordinary pauses
codes.description: A wash, a nip to the shop, a trip to the toilet felt as being caught out, though nobody is looking.

codes.name: Giving back the saved time
codes.description: Longer hours and no breaks, the commute's time paid back to the employer unasked.

codes.name: Others doubting it is real work
codes.description: Family, neighbours and friends treating work at home as not quite work.

codes.name: Home on show
codes.description: The home exposed to work: the room behind the camera, a family heard on a call.

codes.name: Available because I'm at home
codes.description: Parcels, lifts, tradesmen and errands coming to whoever is at home, as if at home means free.

codes.name: Care that lands on the one at home
codes.description: Care for a parent or child given to the one at home, decided without being discussed.

codes.name: Housework in the gaps
codes.description: Housework done in the gaps of the working day, unseen and so uncounted.

codes.name: Whose work counts
codes.description: Whose job gets the room with the door, and whose is the one to give way.

codes.name: Doing both at once, badly
codes.description: Working and caring in the same room at the same time, and doing neither as well as wished.

codes.name: Missing the chat in between
codes.description: The talk between tasks, the Friday sandwich or pint, missed once it is gone.

codes.name: A work self left behind
codes.description: A self that lived at work, with its clothes, desk and humour, and is hard to find at home.

codes.name: Learning a job without people
codes.description: Starting or learning a job through a screen, with nobody to overhear.

codes.name: Relief from the office performance
codes.description: Relief at no longer being on show in an office: the banter, the drinks, being seen at a desk.

codes.name: The journey as time of my own
codes.description: The commute as time that belonged to nobody else, missed or found again.

codes.name: Time handed back
codes.description: Time the commute used to take, given back to the person and their home.

codes.name: Money saved
codes.description: Fares, petrol, parking and lunches no longer paid for.

codes.name: Noise through walls and ceilings
codes.description: Neighbours' and housemates' noise, and one's own, getting in the way of calls.

codes.name: A perk you can't complain about
codes.description: Working from home taken as a perk, so its costs feel ungrateful to say.
